st: And to All a Good Night
d: Ben tries in vain to impress Felicity's mother  Sean schemes to sell Christmas trees  Felicity and the others plan an ill-fated holiday party.
Pandemonium breaks out when a gun is fired at the December party  Felicity, Ben and Noel's lives are changed forever.
A violent storm knocks out the power in Manhattan  a former friend visits Meghan hoping to renew an intimate relationship.
As Felicity and Ben's relationship deteriorates, they are both romanced by people who help ease the pain of a broken heart.
Noel fumes with the knowledge that Ben cheated on Felicity  Ben questions Noel's motives in offering Felicity a job in Seattle.
Ben and Noel exchange blows over Felicity  Sean and Meghan see a couples counselor  Javier is hospitalized after being floored by finals.
Felicity deplores her blighted friendship with Noel, as he gets ready to graduate  Felicity and Ben make plans for the summer  Ruby returns to rekindle her romance with Noel.
